scenario.title: 新公司自我介紹、認識同事
scenario.context: 到新公司第一天，每個人都會問：你之前在哪裡、做這行多久了、住這附近多久了。回答這些問題需要分清楚「已經結束的經歷」（過去式）和「持續到現在的狀態」（現在完成式 + for / since）。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Everyone, this is Minz. She's joining us as our new visual designer.
lines.zh: 各位，這位是 Minz，她是我們的新視覺設計師。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hi everyone! I'm really excited to be here.
lines.zh: 大家好！很高興來到這裡。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Welcome aboard! Where were you before this?
lines.zh: 歡迎加入！你之前在哪裡？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I worked at a branding agency for three years, and I've been freelancing since last spring.
lines.zh: 我在一家品牌設計公司待了三年，從去年春天開始接案。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Nice. So you've done a lot of food and beverage work, right? Karen showed us your portfolio.
lines.zh: 不錯。你做過很多餐飲的案子對吧？Karen 給我們看過你的作品集。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Yeah, I've worked with about fifteen F&B brands so far.
lines.zh: 對，到目前為止跟大概十五個餐飲品牌合作過。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Daniel's been here the longest, so he'll show you the ropes.
lines.zh: Daniel 待最久，他會帶你熟悉環境。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Happy to. Don't worry, we don't bite.
lines.zh: 樂意之至。別擔心，我們不會咬人。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: So how's your first day going?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Good so far! I had some first-day jitters this morning, but everyone's been really nice.
lines.zh: 目前不錯！早上有點新人緊張，但大家都很友善。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Totally normal. I've only been here since March, so I'm still kind of a newbie too.
lines.zh: 很正常。我三月才來，所以我也還算新人。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Really? How long have you lived in this area?
lines.zh: 真的嗎？你在這一區住多久了？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: For about five years. I moved here after grad school.
lines.zh: 大概五年。我研究所畢業後搬來的。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Then you have to tell me all the good lunch spots.
lines.zh: 那你一定要告訴我所有好吃的午餐店。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Deal. And a tip: Karen loves team players. Offer to help and she'll love you.
lines.zh: 成交。給你個建議：Karen 很欣賞有團隊精神的人，主動幫忙她就會喜歡你。

patterns.en: I'm really excited to be here.
I've been in the industry for about five years.

patterns.zh: 在這之前，我在 ___ 工作。

patterns.en: How long have you been here?
Let me know if there's anything I can help with.
patterns.zh: 有什麼我能幫忙的就跟我說。

chinglish.wrong: I work here for three years.
chinglish.right: I've worked here for three years.
chinglish.why: 中文「我在這工作三年了」沒有時態標記。持續到現在的狀態要用現在完成式；用現在式聽起來像「我每次都在這做三年」。
有明確過去時間（in 2020）就用過去式，這是第 12 單元的延伸。

chinglish.wrong: I have lived here since five years.
chinglish.right: I've lived here for five years. / I've lived here since 2021.
chinglish.why: for + 一段時間，since + 起點。中文「五年了」「從 2021 年」都可能翻成 since。

chinglish.wrong: Nice to meet you all, please give me more advices.
chinglish.right: Nice to meet you all. I'm looking forward to working with you.
chinglish.why: 「請多多指教」沒有對應的英文。直接說期待合作就好，而且 advice 不可數。

grammar.title: 現在完成 vs 過去式＋for / since
grammar.oneLiner: 已經結束、有明確時間的事用過去式；從過去一路延續到現在的事用現在完成式。
whenToUse: 過去式：事情已經結束，或有明確過去時間。I worked at an agency for three years.（現在已經不在那）
現在完成式 + for / since：到現在都還是這樣。I've worked here for three years.（現在還在）
for + 一段時間：for two weeks, for ages, for a long time。
since + 起點：since March, since 2023, since I was a kid, since last spring。
問多久：How long have you worked here? / How long have you been here?
經驗（到目前為止）：I've worked with fifteen brands so far.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文用「了」同時處理「已經結束」和「持續到現在」：「我在那工作了三年」（已離職）和「我在這工作三年了」（還在），差別只在「了」的位置。英文把差別放在時態：worked 表示結束了，have worked 表示還在持續。說錯了對方會誤會你已經離職或還在職。

examples.correct: I lived in Tainan for ten years. Now I live in Taipei.
examples.note: 已經不住台南了，用過去式。
從 2019 到現在，用現在完成式。

examples.correct: How long have you known Karen?
examples.incorrect: How long do you know Karen?
examples.note: 問持續多久用現在完成式。

examples.correct: I've been a designer for about eight years.
examples.note: be 動詞的現在完成式：have been。

examples.correct: She joined the company last month.
examples.incorrect: She has joined the company last month.
examples.note: 有 last month 用過去式。

quiz.question: I ___ here since January.
quiz.explanation: since + 起點，持續到現在，用現在完成式。

quiz.question: I ___ at a bank for two years, but I quit in 2023.
How long ___ in Taipei?
quiz.explanation: 問持續到現在多久，用現在完成式。

slang.usage: 剛加入的人，常用來自嘲：I'm still a newbie here.

risk.note: 自稱很自然；叫別人 newbie 通常友善，但不要帶輕蔑語氣。網路用語 noob 就比較帶嘲諷。

examples.en: Go easy on me. I'm the newbie.
We have two newbies starting on Monday.

slang.meaning: 帶新人熟悉環境、教基本做法
slang.usage: the ropes 指「做事的訣竅」。learn the ropes = 學習上手。

examples.en: Amy will show you the ropes this week.
examples.zh: 這週 Amy 會帶你熟悉。

examples.en: It took me a month to learn the ropes.

slang.usage: 願意合作、不只顧自己的人。履歷和面試很常出現。

risk.note: 正面詞，但有時主管用它來暗示你該無償多做事，聽的時候留意語境。

examples.en: She's a real team player. She always helps out.
examples.zh: 她很有團隊精神，總是主動幫忙。

examples.en: We're looking for a team player with strong design skills.
examples.zh: 我們在找有團隊精神、設計能力強的人。

slang.meaning: 第一天上班（上學）的緊張感
slang.usage: jitters = 緊張不安。也可以說 pre-interview jitters、wedding jitters。

examples.en: I always get first-day jitters, even after ten years of working.
examples.zh: 就算工作十年了，我第一天上班還是會緊張。

examples.en: Don't worry, the first-day jitters go away fast.
examples.zh: 別擔心，第一天的緊張很快就會過去。

review.question: Can you ___ me your notes from the meeting?
review.explanation: 複習第 20 單元：借出給我用 lend。

review.question: ___ kind of you to show me around!
review.explanation: 複習第 19 單元：How + 形容詞 + of you。

review.question: You look pale. You ___ go home and rest.
review.explanation: 複習第 17 單元：一般建議用 should。

review.question: The new job is really ___. I learn something every day.
review.explanation: 複習第 13 單元：工作令人興奮用 -ing。

review.question: Could I get ___ information about the benefits?
review.explanation: 複習第 5 單元：information 不可數，用 some。

review.question: Daniel will show you the ___ this week.
review.explanation: show someone the ropes = 帶新人熟悉。
